reason: Free listing I'd maybe let them do if it costs me zero effort, but I wouldn't pay anyone anything on 500 sign-ups. I've been burned by boosts that give no numbers, so I pay when I've seen the audience is real.
objection: 500 people on a waitlist is nothing for a venue like mine, and I don't have time to manage another platform on top of Instagram and the PR guys.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the published monthly active users well past 2,000 in my city, and a stats page showing real views and saves on my nights that I can compare with what my PR guys bring in.
